Cold jump

From a free PDF to $249

A follower who loved a reel can download a guide, and then the next step is a paid checkout. Most cold followers won’t make that jump, so they keep watching for free and never become customers.

Two audiences

One front door for both

Clinicians and people on a personal path arrive at the same homepage and choose their own route. Nothing tells you which followers are therapists, clinicians and coaches, the people your top tier is built for.

No application

The group fills from a waitlist

Your Consultation Group is full and joined by waitlist and email. There’s no application, so you can’t see who is licensed, ready and a good fit before a seat opens up.

The clinicians who’d be perfect for your Consultation Group are already watching your reels. There’s no free room yet where they can learn with you live and raise their hand.

My recommendation

A free live masterclass for clinicians, “Beneath the Behavior”, that sells your Learning Labs and fills your Consultation Group

You already have products people can buy, so the class should be free. A free hour with you replaces the $249 cold jump, an on-demand Learning Lab on the thank-you page earns from day one, and an application on the replay page fills the Consultation Group with the right clinicians.

A free first yes

A free live hour is an easy decision for a follower who isn’t ready to pay. They learn your approach with you in the room, and every sign-up becomes an email you own.

Sorts the clinicians out

The class and the ads speak to professionals about their work with clients, never to anyone’s personal history. Everyone who registers tells you their role, so your list sorts itself.

Fills the group by application

Clinicians who attend, stay and apply have shown you they’re serious. The application checks licence, setting and readiness before a call, and Lab sales help pay for the ads.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready for consultation yet

They get a free class, and some add an on-demand Learning Lab or start The Integrated Path. They stay on your list for the next Lab, the next book and the next cohort.

The qualified 5%

Licensed and ready to go deeper

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them before a call, and the pre-call emails set up the conversation.

Is this you?

You know the theory. Some clients still get stuck in the same place.

  • A client makes real progress in session, then the same reaction shows up again the following week.
  • You’ve met “resistance” that doesn’t move, however carefully you work with it.
  • You’re drawn to parts work and neuroscience, and want to see how they fit together in practice.
  • You want a clear, compassionate frame you can use in session, not another stack of notes.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five ideas we’ll cover live

When “resistance” is protection

How overwhelming experiences shape protective responses, and why pushing against them tends to make them push back.

The pause

Helping a client step back from a reaction and gain clarity before trying to change it.

The story beneath the behavior

How to listen for what a protective part is trying to do, so the behavior starts to make sense.

Reconnecting with strength and wisdom

Why the work goes further when the client leads from their own resources, not yours.

Keeping change in place

What maintenance and relapse prevention look like after the breakthrough session.

Meet Frank

Hi, I’m Frank Anderson

I’m a Harvard-trained psychiatrist and psychotherapist, and I’ve spent about three decades at the intersection of neuroscience and psychotherapy. My work integrates neuroscience, psychotherapy and coaching.

I’m the author of three books, including Transcending Trauma and the Internal Family Systems Skills Training Manual, and I’ve trained more than 10,000 clinicians.

“A passionate, courageous, and inspiring work.”Bessel van der Kolk, MD, author of The Body Keeps the Score, on To Be Loved

Hi [first name],

Something I hear from experienced clinicians after this class: “I already do parts work.”

Many of the clinicians I work with do. Knowing the model isn’t usually where people get stuck. It’s the hard cases: the client who loops, the protector that won’t soften, the session that leaves you unsure what happened.

That’s what consultation is for. Bringing real cases, in a small group, and thinking them through together.

Apply for the next cohort

Frank

Script 1 · “It’s protection”

“If you’re a therapist and a client keeps ‘resisting’, this is for you.”

“In 30 years of practice, I’ve found the behavior we call resistance is often a part working very hard to protect. Push against it and it pushes back. Get curious about it, and the work can move.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a free live masterclass for clinicians called Beneath the Behavior. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Script 2 · “The pause”

“The most useful thing I teach clinicians takes about three seconds.”

“I’ll walk through it live in my free masterclass for therapists, clinicians and coaches. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, slow push-in, on-screen text: Pause first. End card disclaimer.
